issues.title: Linux strict build fails on third-party plugin code; restore v9 secure storage and native tray host coverage

criteria.requirement: Secure storage instances are constructed only through the shared factory with the macOS data-protection keychain option disabled

tests.name: the shared store avoids the data-protection keychain
every secure-storage call site goes through the shared factory

criteria.requirement: Vendored flutter_secure_storage_linux tree matches trusted pristine per-file SHA-256 hashes from the verified pub.dev 1.2.3 archive, with json.hpp matching the recorded patched hash of exactly the four upstream PR #923 UDL lines

tests.name: vendored linux storage tree matches trusted pristine hashes
vendored json.hpp matches recorded patched hash and four-line diff

criteria.requirement: Tray menu entries are validated before native allocation

tests.name: native tray menu accepts all real inactive and active actions
native tray menu rejects duplicate actions before native allocation
native tray menu rejects missing action keys and labels
native tray separators cannot dispatch a menu action

criteria.requirement: Native tray host lifecycle: single icon allocation, click and menu ID dispatch, deferred cleanup, partial-release on failure, idempotent dispose

tests.name: native host allocates one icon and dispatches clicks and menu IDs
native host defers old menu cleanup until callbacks return
native host rejects allocation failures and releases partial menu
native host dispose disables callbacks and is idempotent

criteria.requirement: Tray publication ordering, kill switch, held-request fencing, active-change-only republish, held sampling and explicit error recovery

tests.name: native menu specification preserves order and kill switch
initial publication orders icon, title, menu exactly once
only active changes publish a new menu; title ticks do not
pending icon requests join and disposal fences successor
pending title requests join and disposal fences successor
pending menu requests join and disposal fences successor
native icon error consumed and explicitly recovered
native title error consumed and explicitly recovered
native menu error consumed and explicitly recovered
native icon samples latest state while operation is held
native title samples latest state while operation is held
native menu samples latest state while operation is held
